questions.answer: Very easy. Everyone is so kind, making it very welcoming and easy to get acquainted with a different culture.

questions.answer: Very easy. Everyone is so kind, making it very welcoming and easy to get acquainted with a different country.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with locals? *
questions.answer: Be yourself, be open, be welcoming. Share things about yourself and your culture as well. Plan things to do on your downtime with anyone who would like to socialize so that you get to know each other in different settings.

questions.answer: Everyone was very welcoming and kind. They would help me if I was lost or had any questions.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going on a traineeship to the same city/region? *
questions.answer: Enjoy the food. Be in the present moment. Drink lots of water.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your traineeship experience? *
questions.answer: Building connections and friendships with locals. I am still in contact with them today.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the traineeship? *
questions.answer: Having spotty internet access - makes it a little difficult when you need to work online.

questions.question: Is there anything UCPH could have done different (before/during/after) in regard to the traineeship experience? *
questions.answer: Highlight the visa process and timeline - it was quite difficult to understand the process before we asked for help.
